summary: Jackson County, OR: a 50-foot pole tower dated 1933 (or late 1934), an L-4 cab from 1959, lost in 1967; a 2007 Peakbagging photo shows radio gear on the summit.

facts.design: 50-foot pole tower with a 12-by-12-foot cab (1933); L-4 cab from 1959
facts.status_note: Lookout removed or destroyed in 1967 per the sources; a 2007 photo on Peakbagging shows radio gear on the summit and no lookout

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with a 12-by-12-foot cab (register and firelookout.com); Forest Lookouts newspaper items put construction in late 1934

L-4 cab replaced the original cab (register and firelookout.com); Forest Lookouts records complete remodeling that year
Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts say destroyed; the register says the L-4 cab was removed

corrections.why: Both registers describe a 50-foot pole tower with a cab, not a ground-level cabin

notes_for_editor: Built year is disputed: register and firelookout.com give 1933; Forest Lookouts newspaper items show the road surveyed in April 1934 and the tower built late in 1934. Destroyed (firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts) vs removed (register) in 1967. Land manager disputed: register says Oregon Department of Forestry; Peakbagging says BLM land. Elevation 4,494 ft in register and firelookout.com vs 4,498 ft on Peakbagging; the record's 1369.8 m matches the 4,494 ft figure. The 15.2 m height is 50 ft converted and applies to the original pole tower. Peakbagging's radio-gear statement rests on an August 2007 photo, so 'now' may be out of date. No source describes public access.
